text: LXV. 1. Cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame cha? 2. Assaddhiyaṃ, ahirikaṃ, anottappaṃ, kosajjaṃ, muṭṭhasaccaṃ, duppaññataṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikātuṃ. 3. Cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame cha? 4. Assaddhiyaṃ, ahirikaṃ, anottappaṃ, kosajjaṃ, muṭṭhasaccaṃ, duppaññataṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikātun ti.
